title: Issuance of certificate of compliance.

blocks.html:
Upon satisfactory inspection of service equipment and the satisfaction of all the
requirements for sign-off, the department shall issue a certificate of compliance as applicable for the following service equipment:
1. Elevators;
2. Escalators;
3. Moving walkways;
4. Heating systems; and
5. Dumbwaiters.

historicalConstructionCode.sourceAuthority: New York City Department of Buildings
